verdict.rationale: Customer.io's own automations include a 'Goals' component alongside trigger, exit criteria and workflow, which points to conversion tracking per flow. Its AI can also 'analyze performance' and 'report on how your messages perform.' However, nothing in the pack shows goals attributing signups or revenue to specific emails or flows beyond opens and clicks. Missing for 10: documented conversion or goal attribution per message and flow, revenue attribution (e.g. purchase-value tracking), attribution windows or reporting UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
